newsitem.title: USA: Norland Medical says suit is without merit.
newsitem.headline: Norland Medical says suit is without merit.

text.p: Norland Medical Systems Inc said Wednesday that a shareholder lawsuit charging the company with breach of fiduciary responsibilities, loyalty and candor in connection with the company's pending acquisition of Norland Corporation is without merit.
Norland Corporation, is the exclusive worldwide supplier to Norland Medical Systems.

The company said, "the purported shareholder's class action and derivative complaint entitled Irwin I. Miller v. Reynald G. Bonmati et.al..." was filed in the Court of the Chancery of the State of Delaware, on Aug 1. Mr. Bonmati is the president of Norland Medical Systems.
The company said its shareholders will make the final decision about the acquisition at an Aug 20 scheduled meeting.

The company said the complaint "alleges that the individual defendants breached their fiduciary duties of loyalty, candor and care in connection with the pending acquisition, and that the company's proxy statement relating to the shareholders meeting does not contain full and fair disclosure with respect to the acquisition."
